title: GitHub Integration UX Surface Map v1

surfaces.title: GitHub Operating Picture Dashboard
surfaces.user_story: As an operator, I want a single-pane overview of all connected GitHub repos so I can understand repository health, activity, and agent work at a glance.
surfaces.cockpit_location: Operator mode, primary widget grid position 1-1 (top-left)
surfaces.permission_boundary: metadata:read, contents:read, pull_requests:read
surfaces.failure_empty_state: No repositories connected. Show GitHub App installation wizard with 'Connect a Repository' CTA. If token expired, show 'Re-authenticate GitHub App' prompt with last-known-good timestamp.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: Live GitHub data unavailable. Trust spine prerequisites (permission probe, rate-limit budget, content-light scan) must complete before this surface shows live data.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: No GitHub data received. Ensure GitHub App is installed and trust spine prerequisites are complete.
surfaces.test_strategy: Snapshot tests with captured operating picture fixture; contract tests against GitHub sandbox org.

surfaces.title: Repository Health Cockpit
surfaces.user_story: As a maintainer, I want to see repository health signals (archived/disabled, branch protection gaps, stale PRs, vulnerability counts) so I can prioritize maintenance work.
surfaces.cockpit_location: Operator mode, widget grid position 1-2 (top-center)
surfaces.permission_boundary: metadata:read, administration:read, security_events:read
surfaces.failure_empty_state: Repository metadata not yet fetched. Show 'Refresh Repository Health' button. If no branch protection data, show 'Enable branch protection to see health score' educational state.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: Live GitHub data unavailable. Trust spine prerequisites (permission probe, rate-limit budget, content-light scan) must complete before this surface shows live data.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: No GitHub data received. Ensure GitHub App is installed and trust spine prerequisites are complete.
surfaces.test_strategy: Snapshot tests with repo health fixture matrix (healthy, degraded, critical, unknown); contract tests.

surfaces.title: PR Intelligence Panel
surfaces.user_story: As a reviewer, I want to see all open PRs with mergeability status, CI rollup, review state, and code scanning findings so I can triage and review effectively.
surfaces.cockpit_location: Review mode, widget grid position 2-1 (center-left)
surfaces.permission_boundary: pull_requests:read, checks:read, security_events:read
surfaces.failure_empty_state: No open pull requests. Show 'Open your first PR' CTA with branch comparison picker. If PRs exist but CI status unavailable, show 'Configure CI to see status checks' prompt.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: PR mutation surfaces are blocked. Trust spine, dry-run/rehearsal, approval receipts, branch protection preflight, and no-surprise mutation tests must all be proven before PR write operations are enabled.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: No open pull requests detected.
surfaces.test_strategy: Snapshot tests with PR fixture set (draft, ready, mergeable, conflicted, CI-passing, CI-failing); contract tests.

surfaces.title: Issue-to-Mission Converter
surfaces.user_story: As an operator, I want to turn a labeled GitHub issue into a Rig Relay mission so an agent can autonomously work on it in an isolated worktree.
surfaces.cockpit_location: Operator mode, widget grid position 2-2 (center)
surfaces.permission_boundary: issues:read; mutation requires ralph worktree lane with HMAC attestation
surfaces.failure_empty_state: No issues found or GitHub issues permission not granted. Show 'Enable Issues permission for your GitHub App' prompt. If issues exist but none are labeled, show 'Label issues to make them convertible to missions' with label taxonomy.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: This surface requires PostgreSQL operational projection spine. GitHub data is flowing through trust spine but Postgres-backed indexed projections do not yet exist.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: PostgreSQL operational projection not yet available. GitHub data is preserved in JSONL source-of-truth artifacts pending Postgres adapter implementation.
surfaces.test_strategy: Integration tests with synthetic issue fixture; snapshot tests for converter UI states.

surfaces.title: Code Scanning Triage Queue
surfaces.user_story: As a security reviewer, I want to triage code scanning alerts by severity, tool, and rule so I can review findings and approve or reject agent-proposed fixes.
surfaces.cockpit_location: Review mode, widget grid position 1-1 (top-left)
surfaces.permission_boundary: security_events:read; mutation requires pull_requests:write with HMAC-SHA256 attestation
surfaces.failure_empty_state: No code scanning alerts found. Show 'Enable CodeQL or third-party code scanning to populate this queue' educational state. If alerts exist but user lacks security_events:read, show permission grant instructions.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: Provider trust spine has not completed. Permission probe, rate-limit budget, and content-light scan must be established before this surface can display live data.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: No GitHub App installation detected. Complete GitHub App onboarding to enable permission transparency.
surfaces.test_strategy: Snapshot tests for triage queue states (open, dismissed, fixed, false-positive); contract tests with alert fixture; mutation rehearsal in sandbox repo.

surfaces.title: Secret Scanning Triage Queue
surfaces.user_story: As a security reviewer, I want to triage secret scanning alerts without ever seeing secret values so I can verify and resolve leaked credentials safely.
surfaces.cockpit_location: Review mode, widget grid position 1-2 (top-center)
surfaces.permission_boundary: security_events:read; NEVER expose secret fragments in UI or telemetry
surfaces.failure_empty_state: No secret scanning alerts. Show 'Enable secret scanning for this repository' in settings. If alerts exist but are all resolved, show 'All secrets resolved — great job!' celebratory state.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: This surface is blocked until content-light leak scanning is proven for all secret-bearing and log-bearing GitHub data. Raw secret fragments and Actions log bodies must never reach cockpit projections.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: Security alert ingestion not yet active. Complete trust spine prerequisites before enabling this surface.
surfaces.test_strategy: Snapshot tests with sanitized fixture (no real secrets); content-light guard verification tests.

surfaces.failure_empty_state: No Dependabot alerts — dependencies are up to date. Show 'Enable Dependabot on this repo' if Dependabot is not configured. Show ecosystem breakdown if Dependabot is active but no open alerts.
surfaces.blocked_state_copy: Live GitHub data unavailable. Trust spine prerequisites (permission probe, rate-limit budget, content-light scan) must complete before this surface shows live data.
surfaces.safe_empty_state: No GitHub data received. Ensure GitHub App is installed and trust spine prerequisites are complete.
surfaces.test_strategy: Snapshot tests with multi-ecosystem fixture; contract tests.

governance_notes: All mutation-capable surfaces (code-scanning fixes, issue-to-mission, PR merge) require HMAC-SHA256 attestation per Live Mutation Readiness policy
Surfaces handling credentials (secret scanning triage, GitHub App token health) must never expose token/secret values in UI or telemetry
Every surface with content_light constraints must pass through sanitize_env_for_subprocess or content-light projection before rendering
Empty/failure states are designed per surface — never show raw error logs or stack traces to users
Provider Health Panel is the only surface that already exists; all others are proposed
